_README: Campus Accounting Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 Edition (External Services, printed pp. 578-585). effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Each service lists all Charter transaction types in transaction_types. Standards carry duration_days, duration_hours and duration_minutes exactly as printed. Each service also carries service_scope. See CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.4. Review before importing.

services.fees: None. See other fees below. Formula / Schedule of Fees: SIS List of Fees - Depends on the result of the SIS data
services.who_may_avail: All graduating applicants and students who will transfer outside of PUP
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Submit accomplished General Clearance Form at the Student Services Section Sign on the 'Received' column on the logbook Location: Campus Office of the Student Services, Cashier's Office, Accounting Section
  1.1. Check if General Clearance Form is properly accomplished [Responsible: Office of the Student Services Staff, Accounting Section]
  1.2. Check Student's account in his/her SIS [Responsible: Office of the Student Services Staff, Accounting Section]
  1.3. If there are no balances found, please proceed to Step 1.4 but If a balance appears, he/she must go to the Cashier's Office to settle his/her outstanding balance and then go back to the Student Services Section for verification of payment made. If there are no balances found, please proceed to Step 1.4 [Responsible: Cashier's Office]
  1.4. Sign the General Clearance Form if there are no balances [Responsible: Office of the Student Services, Staff, Accounting Section]

documents.notes: (1) Original Copy. Where to secure: Polytechnic University of the Philippines - Campus PUP Registrar's Office 'Receiving Section' or PUP Website. Remarks: PUP Registrar's Office 'Receiving Section' or PUP Website 'www.pup.edu.ph'

services.who_may_avail: All students who are currently enrolled.
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Present PUP ID's and/or Registration Card at the Student Services Section and Sign on the 'Received' column on the logbook Location: Section Staff, Accounting Department Campus and Main Campus Notes/Instruction: Processing Time for 1.1. 3 minutes (depends upon the internet connectivity)
  1.1. Check in the SIS If the student is entitled for off-setting [Responsible: Section Staff, Accounting Department]
  1.2. Make proper and valid adjustments in the students account in the SIS. if the Student is entitled for offsetting, the CDO will request for the offsetting of the student thru the email of accounting student services section with the student details or information [Responsible: Section Staff, Accounting Department; Any of requesting office / division]
  1.3. Inform student that it's finished. And advise the students to check their SIS account for the updates [Responsible: Section Staff, Accounting Department; Any of requesting office / division]

services.who_may_avail: All students who are assessed to have an overpayment in their account.
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Submit all requirements in the Student Services Section and wait for further instruction from the Students Services Section personnel and Sign on the 'Received' column on the logbook Location: Campus Student Services Section; Location of from 1.3 to 1.6 1.3 Budget Office (PUP Main Campus) 1.4 Accounting Office, Main Campus (BSO) 1.5 Accounting Office, Budget Office - Main Campus (BSO) 1.6 Fund Management Office, Releasing Section (PUP Main Campus) Notes/Instruction: 1.3 Processing TIme 3 Days (Under normal conditions via courier)
  1.1. Check if all documents are complete and remind the client if its proper and complete [Responsible: Student Services Section Staff]
  1.2. Process the request (Disbursement Voucher) [Responsible: Student Services Section Staff, Accounting Section]
  1.3. Submit Disbursement Voucher for transmittal to the Budget Office, thru OVPC,Main Campus [Responsible: Budget Office, PUP Main Campus]
  1.4. Processing of the refund [Responsible: Accounting Office staff, Main Campus (BSO)]
  1.5. Follow up the status and/or availability of the check [Responsible: Campus Director and/or CDO/Liaison Officer Budget Office and OVPC]
  1.6. Pick up check from the Main Campus [Responsible: Campus Director and/or CDO/Liaison Officer Fund Management Office, Releasing Section]
Step 2. Present two (2) valid ID's and/or Letter of Authorization if person in the check is not available and Sign on the 'Received' column on the logbook Location: Campus Cashiers Office
  2. Release the check [Responsible: Cashiers Office]
